123327: An amnesiac little girl who finds herself in a mysterious building.
123328: An illiterate serial killer in charge of floor B6, the lowest in the building. He despises liars and dishonesty above all else and sees himself as a monster. His favourite weapon is a scythe, which was given to him by Gray.
123329: Master of floor B4. A very immature gravedigger who's grown infatuated with Rachel after seeing her documents, often seen obsessed with the idea of giving her the most beautiful burial and grave he can. He despises Zack for his lack of subtlety and finesse.
123330: A psychiatrist in charge of floor B5 who claims to have been Ray's counselor. Despite his gentle facade, he hides a much more sinister persona. He was born without his right eye, alienating him from other kids and adults alike.
123331: An ex-prison guard in charge of floor B3 of the building, thoroughly devoted to her role as a self-proclaimed judge and executioner, guided by her twisted sense of justice.
127275: An extremely eloquent and stern elderly priest residing in a cathedral on floor B2. He attempts to make Ray doubt her choices and beliefs, being deeply obsessed with exploring what religious beliefs truly mean to people.
